scope: Six bundled planetary windows against the three eligible bundled Earth references only. Browser-local searches and unknown Earth locations are not evaluated.

source.title: MGS MOLA MEGDR MEGT44N000HB, 128 pixels per degree
source.datum: Topography relative to Mars areoid (GMM3 model), IAU2000 planetocentric coordinates
source.sampling: Bilinear sample of 1/128 degree MOLA grid at 500 m local spacing.
source.caveat: Cells without altimeter returns are interpolated in the source. Some source-track gaps can reach 12 km. This grid is not a rover-scale hazard map.

source.title: LRO LOLA LDEM_75S_240M, V2.0
source.datum: Height relative to 1,737,400 m lunar sphere; DE421 mean Earth/polar axis frame
source.sampling: Bilinear sample in lunar south-polar stereographic coordinates at 500 m spacing; label specifies little-endian signed 16-bit DN × 0.5 metres.
source.caveat: Source ground tracks are interpolated using GMT surface. Grid axes are projected X/Y, not global north/east. Illumination, shadows and ice have not been calculated.

source.title: LRO LOLA LDEM_75S_240M, V2.0
source.datum: Radial height relative to a 1,737,400 m sphere, DE421 mean Earth/polar axis frame.
source.sampling: Bilinear source-pixel-center sampling in south-polar stereographic coordinates at 500 m projected intervals; little-endian signed DN × 0.5 m.

observationSupport.note: LOLA gridding interpolates tracks. No separate per-cell observation-count or uncertainty layer was acquired.

source.caveat: Projected spacing is not exact geodesic spacing away from the pole. Source ground tracks are interpolated. No illumination, permanent-shadow, ice or landing-safety analysis is implied.
source.coordinateNote: Rounded Gazetteer crater center, not the LCROSS impact coordinate or an approved base site.

source.title: LRO LOLA LDEM_75S_240M, V2.0
source.datum: Radial height relative to a 1,737,400 m sphere, DE421 mean Earth/polar axis frame.
source.sampling: Bilinear source-pixel-center sampling in south-polar stereographic coordinates at 500 m projected intervals; little-endian signed DN × 0.5 m.

observationSupport.note: LOLA gridding interpolates tracks. No separate per-cell observation-count or uncertainty layer was acquired.

source.caveat: Projected spacing is not exact geodesic spacing away from the pole. Source ground tracks are interpolated. No illumination, permanent-shadow, ice or landing-safety analysis is implied.
source.coordinateNote: Rounded Gazetteer crater center, not the western-rim region in the historical 2021 VIPER announcement.

source.title: MGS MOLA MEGDR MEGT00N090HB, 128 pixels per degree
source.datum: Topography relative to the Mars areoid, IAU2000 planetocentric coordinates, east-positive longitude.
source.sampling: Pixel-center-correct bilinear sampling of the native 128 ppd MOLA grids at 500 m local projected spacing, including tile/seam support.

observationSupport.note: Counts describe native source bins, not direct measurements at each output sample. Zero-count bins retain archived interpolated heights. Counts are not accuracy or analog-confidence percentages.

source.caveat: Native cells without altimeter returns are interpolated in the source; track gaps can reach 12 km. Posting is not effective measurement accuracy. This is not a rover-scale hazard map.
source.coordinateNote: Published historical Curiosity landing coordinate; not the current rover position or the center of the entire Gale crater.

source.title: MGS MOLA MEGDR MEGT00N270HB, 128 pixels per degree
source.datum: Topography relative to the Mars areoid, IAU2000 planetocentric coordinates, east-positive longitude.
source.sampling: Pixel-center-correct bilinear sampling of the native 128 ppd MOLA grids at 500 m local projected spacing, including tile/seam support.

observationSupport.note: Counts describe native source bins, not direct measurements at each output sample. Zero-count bins retain archived interpolated heights. Counts are not accuracy or analog-confidence percentages.

source.caveat: Native cells without altimeter returns are interpolated in the source; track gaps can reach 12 km. Posting is not effective measurement accuracy. This is not a rover-scale hazard map.
source.coordinateNote: Project study-window center uses the HiRISE DTM page approximate center -23.8 degrees, 326.3 degrees E, normalized to -33.7 degrees. HiRISE pixels are not ingested; this audit uses MOLA.

source.title: Skadi terrain tile (SRTM and other elevation sources)
source.datum: Earth elevation in metres from the Skadi HGT derivative; consult underlying source documentation
source.sampling: Bilinear sample of native HGT grid at 500 m projected spacing; no invented height detail.
source.caveat: Distribution tiles can combine underlying sources; the source is identified as Skadi, not an unmodified Earthdata product.

source.title: Skadi terrain tile (SRTM and other elevation sources)
source.datum: Earth elevation in metres from the Skadi HGT derivative; consult underlying source documentation
source.sampling: Bilinear sample of native HGT grid at 500 m projected spacing; no invented height detail.
source.caveat: Distribution tiles can combine underlying sources; the source is identified as Skadi, not an unmodified Earthdata product.

source.title: Skadi terrain tile (SRTM and other elevation sources)
source.datum: Earth elevation in metres from the Skadi HGT derivative; consult underlying source documentation
source.sampling: Bilinear sample of native HGT grid at 500 m projected spacing; no invented height detail.
source.caveat: This island window intersects coastal/ocean terrain; the terrain score is sensitive to the window and is not an inland-only assessment.

source.title: Skadi terrain tile (SRTM and other elevation sources)
source.datum: Earth elevation in metres from the Skadi HGT derivative; consult underlying source documentation
source.sampling: Bilinear sample of native HGT grid at 500 m projected spacing; no invented height detail.
source.caveat: US Skadi tiles can use USGS 3DEP/NED rather than SRTM; this is not labelled as pure NASA data.
